key_insight: LLM agents can turn natural-language household preferences into reliable home energy schedules, achieving near-MILP performance when paired with tool calling and live energy data.
engineering_relevance: This work shows a practical path for deploying agentic HEMS that optimize flexible loads, reduce electricity costs, and support demand response with minimal user burden.
method: Uses live Octopus Agile prices, weather forecasts, PV estimates, usage data, and a retrieval-augmented knowledge base
Benchmarked against MILP ground truth across tariff, conflict, solar-aware, and week-long scenarios
evidence_signal: Across GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, native function calling yielded 100% scheduling success and 96.7-98.0% of oracle savings over a simulated week.
watch_item: Reliability drops sharply when actions are text-parsed instead of native function calls, so deployment should prioritize robust tool interfaces and constraint handling.
paper_title: LLMs for Agentic Home Energy Management
